WITH principal AS ( SELECT mm.smaller_amount as Mini, mml.code as A, it.dian_code as B, rp.vat as C, rp.l10n_co_verification_code as D, rp.lastname1 as E, rp.lastname2 as F, rp.name1 as G, rp.name2 as H, rp.name as I, rp.street as J, rcs.dian_code as K, SUBSTRING(rcsc.dian_code, 3) as L, rc.medios_code as M, (CASE WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'N' AND mmlc.type = 'd' THEN SUM(aml.debit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'N' AND mmlc.type = 'c' THEN SUM(aml.credit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'N' AND mmlc.type = 'sf' THEN SUM(aml.debit-aml.credit) WHEN mmlc.sequence = 'N' AND mmlc.type = 'bi' THEN SUM(aml.tax_base_amount) END ) as N FROM mag_media mm INNER JOIN mag_media_lines mml ON mml.magnetic_id = mm.id INNER JOIN mag_media_lines_concepts mmlc ON mmlc.line_id = mml.id INNER JOIN ( select aammlcr.account_account_id as account_id, aammlcr.mag_media_lines_concepts_id as concept_id from account_account_mag_media_lines_concepts_rel aammlcr union all select aaat.account_account_id as account_id, mmlcaat.concept_ids as concept_id from mag_media_lines_concepts_account_account_tag mmlcaat inner join account_account_tag aat on aat.id = mmlcaat.tag_ids inner join account_account_account_tag aaat on aaat.account_account_tag_id = aat.id ) AS aa ON aa.concept_id = mmlc.id INNER JOIN account_move_line aml ON aml.account_id = aa.account_id LEFT JOIN res_partner rp ON rp.id = aml.partner_id LEFT JOIN l10n_latam_identification_type it ON it.id = rp.l10n_latam_identification_type_id LEFT JOIN res_country_state rcs ON rcs.id = rp.state_id LEFT JOIN res_city rcsc ON rcsc.id = rp.city_id LEFT JOIN res_country rc ON rc.id = rp.country_id WHERE mm.id = {id} -- AND aml.date BETWEEN '{date_from}' AND '{date_to}' AND aml.date <= '{date_to}' AND aml.parent_state = 'posted' AND aml.company_id = {company_id} GROUP BY mml.code, it.dian_code, rp.vat, rp.l10n_co_verification_code, rp.name1, rp.name2, rp.lastname1, rp.lastname2, rp.name, rp.street, rcs.dian_code, rcsc.dian_code, rc.medios_code, mmlc.sequence, mmlc.type, mm.smaller_amount ) SELECT A as "Concepto", B as "Tipo documento", C as "Número identificación del deudor", D as "DV", E as "Primer apellido del deudor", F as "Segundo apellido del deudor", G as "Primer nombre del deudor", H as "Segundo nombre del deudor", I as "Razón social del deudor", J as "Direccion del deudor", K as "Código departamento", L as "Código municipio", M as "País de residencia o domicilio", ROUND(N, 0) as "Saldo cuentas por cobrar al 31-12" FROM ( SELECT A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M, SUM(N) AS N FROM principal GROUP BY A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M, Mini HAVING SUM(N) >= Mini::float
UNION
SELECT A, '43' as B, '222222222' as C, '7' as D, '' as E, '' as F, '' as G, '' as H, 'CUANTIAS MENORES' as I, NULL as J, NULL as K, NULL as L, NULL as M, SUM(N) as N FROM ( SELECT A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M, SUM(N) AS N, Mini FROM principal GROUP BY A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M, Mini HAVING SUM(N) < Mini::float ) AS cm GROUP BY A, Mini ) AS datos ORDER BY A, B, C
